TAGLINE.en: While the lantern burns, there is a way home.

PROTOTYPE.zh_CN: N1 · 三职业开发原型 / 原创工坊界面 / 键盘与鼠标
PROTOTYPE.en: N1 · THREE-HERO PROTOTYPE / ORIGINAL WORKSHOP UI / KEYBOARD + MOUSE

NO_PROFILE.zh_CN: 尚无永久档案，请先建立拾荒者档案。
NO_PROFILE.en: No profile yet. Create a salvager to begin.

CAMP_SUB.zh_CN: 修整装备，选择自己的下井方式。
CAMP_SUB.en: Fit your equipment. Choose how you descend.

LOADOUT.zh_CN: 拾荒者 · 火花发射器

LOADOUT_NOTE.zh_CN: 生命 100  /  角色与起始武器永久保留
LOADOUT_NOTE.en: 100 health / Your salvager and starter weapon are permanent

START.zh_CN: 乘升降机 · 开始远征

RULES.zh_CN:
撤离带回全部金币和装备；死亡保留50%金币，放弃保留50%（向下取整）。
战败时本房击杀每只积累2经验，最多18；遗物随本局结束清空。
RULES.en:
Extract with all gold and equipment. Death keeps 50% gold; abandoning keeps 50%, rounded down.
Defeat saves 2 XP per unfinished-room kill, up to 18. Run relics expire.

FIELD_NOTE.zh_CN:
矿井记录  /  01

三座遗物装置仍有余光。靠近后按 E 拾取，改变火花弹的攻击。

击倒守卫，回收金币，再回到西侧升降机撤离。
FIELD_NOTE.en:
FIELD NOTE / 01

Three relic stations still glow. Approach and press E to alter your spark caster.

Defeat the wardens, collect their gold, and return to the western lift.

REGION.zh_CN: 裂灯矿井 / 测试井室 01

ACTIONS.zh_CN: WASD 移动  ·  鼠标瞄准 / 左键连射  ·  空格冲刺  ·  E 交互
ACTIONS.en: WASD MOVE · MOUSE AIM / LEFT CLICK FIRE · Space DASH · E INTERACT

HUD_HINT.zh_CN: Tab 作战详情 / Esc 暂停

NO_RELICS.zh_CN: 尚未携带遗物 · 靠近发光装置按 E 拾取
NO_RELICS.en: NO RELICS · APPROACH A GLOWING STATION AND PRESS E

RELIC_SPLIT_DESC.zh_CN: 主弹首次命中产生 2 枚侧向子弹，各造成基础伤害的 40%。子弹不能继续分裂。
RELIC_SPLIT_DESC.en: The first main-shot hit creates 2 side projectiles, each dealing 40% base damage. Child projectiles cannot split again.

RELIC_EMBER_DESC.zh_CN: 武器弹命中附加燃烧，每秒 3 点伤害，持续 3 秒。再次命中只刷新时长，不叠层。
RELIC_EMBER_DESC.en: Weapon hits apply a 3-second burn for 3 damage per second. Further hits refresh its duration without stacking.

RELIC_ARC_DESC.zh_CN: 每第 3 次普攻主弹首次命中触发电弧，连接最多 2 个其他目标，各造成基础伤害的 35%。
RELIC_ARC_DESC.en: Every third main shot arcs on its first hit to up to 2 other nearby targets, each for 35% base damage.

PAUSED_NOTE.zh_CN: 战斗已暂停。返回后松开操作键，再继续行动。
PAUSED_NOTE.en: Combat is paused. Release action keys after resuming to continue.

ABANDON_NOTE.zh_CN:
主动放弃保留50%金币（向下取整）：携带 {gold}，保留 {kept}，损失 {lost}。
本房不结算战斗积累经验；待带回装备丢失，本局遗物清空。
ABANDON_NOTE.en:
Abandoning keeps 50% of gold, rounded down: {gold} carried, {kept} kept, {lost} lost.
No field practice XP from this room. Unbanked equipment and run relics are lost.

CONFIRM_ABANDON.zh_CN: 确认放弃 · 保留20%金币

EXTRACT_NOTE.zh_CN:
现在撤离可带回 {gold} 金币。
若倒在井下，只能保留 {kept}。本局遗物结束后清空，发现记录永久保留。
EXTRACT_NOTE.en:
Extract now to bank {gold} gold.
If you fall, only {kept} survives. Run relics are cleared; their discovery records are permanent.

SETTLED.zh_CN: 结算已保存 · 奖励已入账

RESULT_STATS.zh_CN:
击败守卫 {kills}  /  新发现 {discoveries}
起始角色与武器保留，本局遗物已清空。
RESULT_STATS.en:
Wardens defeated: {kills} / New discoveries: {discoveries}
Starter gear retained. Run relics have been cleared.

NEW_CONFIRM_NOTE.zh_CN: 将覆盖当前永久金币、发现记录与远征统计。此操作不能从游戏内撤销。
NEW_CONFIRM_NOTE.en: This replaces your banked gold, discoveries, and expedition history. It cannot be undone from the game.

LANGUAGE.zh_CN: 语言 · 简体中文 → English

FULLSCREEN_ON.zh_CN: 显示 · 全屏（点击切换）

FULLSCREEN_OFF.zh_CN: 显示 · 窗口（点击切换）

FX_ON.zh_CN: 效果 · 低闪烁（已开启）

FX_OFF.zh_CN: 效果 · 低闪烁（已关闭）

CONTROLS.zh_CN:
WASD / 方向键 移动 · 鼠标瞄准 · 鼠标左键连续普攻 · 空格闪避
Q / 鼠标右键 / F / R 技能（角色等级 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 解锁）
C 放置引雷桩 · V 释放回路 · E 交互 · Tab 作战详情 · Esc 暂停。
CONTROLS.en:
WASD / arrows move · Mouse aim · Hold left click to attack · Space dodge
Q / Right click / F / R skills (hero levels 1 / 2 / 3 / 4)
C place anchors · V discharge · E interact · Tab details · Esc pause.

SAVE_ERROR.zh_CN:
无法写入存档。请检查磁盘空间与目录权限，再重试。
{error}
SAVE_ERROR.en:
Could not write the save. Check disk space and folder permissions, then retry.
{error}

LAST_RUN.zh_CN: 最近一次远征：入库 {gold} 金币

STORAGE_ABANDONED_RECOVERED.zh_CN: 上次远征异常结束，已按放弃规则结算一次。
STORAGE_ABANDONED_RECOVERED.en: The interrupted expedition was settled once using abandonment rules.

STORAGE_PRESERVE_FAILED.zh_CN: 无法保留损坏的存档文件，已停止写入。
STORAGE_PRESERVE_FAILED.en: Could not preserve the damaged save. Writes are stopped.

STORAGE_CORRUPT_PRESERVED.zh_CN: 损坏文件已保留供检查。
STORAGE_CORRUPT_PRESERVED.en: The damaged file has been preserved for inspection.

STORAGE_NO_VALID_PROFILE.zh_CN: 没有可恢复的有效档案。损坏文件已保留，请检查存档目录。
STORAGE_NO_VALID_PROFILE.en: No valid profile could be recovered. Damaged files are preserved; inspect the save directory.

STORAGE_RECOVERED.zh_CN: 已从完整的备份事务恢复档案。
STORAGE_RECOVERED.en: The profile was recovered from a complete backup transaction.

STORAGE_INVALID_DATA.zh_CN: 存档数据未通过校验，未修改已保存档案。
STORAGE_INVALID_DATA.en: Save validation failed. The saved profile was not changed.

STORAGE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.zh_CN: 存档超过安全容量，本次操作未保存；原存档与备份保持不变。请保留现有档案并更新游戏。
STORAGE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.en: Save capacity exceeded. This change was not saved; your prior save and backup are intact. Keep the existing files and update the game.

STORAGE_TRANSACTION_CAPACITY.zh_CN: 交易收据已达到4096条上限，本次交易未执行；请保留存档并更新游戏，不能删除收据绕过保护。
STORAGE_TRANSACTION_CAPACITY.en: The 4,096-receipt limit is reached. This transaction was not applied. Keep your save and update the game; do not delete receipts.

STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED.zh_CN: 写入失败，请检查磁盘空间与目录权限。
STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED.en: Write failed. Check disk space and folder permissions.

STORAGE_REPLACE_FAILED.zh_CN: 存档替换未完成，可以重试。
STORAGE_REPLACE_FAILED.en: Save replacement did not finish. Please retry.

STORAGE_DUPLICATE_RUN.zh_CN: 此远征已经结算，不能再次发放奖励。
STORAGE_DUPLICATE_RUN.en: This expedition was already settled. Rewards cannot be issued again.

RELIC_ACQUIRED.zh_CN: 已获得 · {name}  /  Tab 查看机制

WORKSHOP_KICKER.zh_CN: 裂灯矿务局 / 地表工坊 · 永久档案
WORKSHOP_KICKER.en: FRACTURED LANTERN / SURFACE WORKSHOP · PERMANENT RECORD

EXPEDITION_LOOP.zh_CN:
远征收集 → 安全撤离 → 打磨配装 → 深入矿井
三位英雄独立成长，共享永久装备与营地金币。
EXPEDITION_LOOP.en:
Explore → Extract → Refine your build → Descend further
Heroes grow separately; camp gold and equipment are shared.

DOSSIER_STATS.zh_CN:
生命 {hp}  /  护甲 {armor}
普攻基础伤害 {damage}

HERO_DOSSIERS.zh_CN: 出勤档案 · 选择英雄

EQUIPMENT_BENCH.zh_CN: 装备台 · 仓库与配装

SUPPLY_CATALOG.zh_CN: 采购目录 · 营地商店

NEXT_SKILL.zh_CN: 下一成长节点 / 角色等级 {level}

RESOURCE_RAGE_RULE.zh_CN:
怒气 · 无蓝条
普攻命中积攒怒气；脱离战斗后逐渐衰减。零怒气仍可普攻与冲刺。
RESOURCE_RAGE_RULE.en:
RAGE · NO MANA
Basic hits build rage; it decays out of combat. Attacks and dash remain free.

RESOURCE_ENERGY_RULE.zh_CN:
能量 · 无蓝条
技能消耗后短暂停顿，再快速恢复。交替射击与换位，保留脱身余量。
RESOURCE_ENERGY_RULE.en:
ENERGY · NO MANA
Regenerates quickly after a short delay. Alternate firing and repositioning.

RESOURCE_MANA_RULE.zh_CN:
法力 · 蓝条
法力缓慢回复。部署节点、控制敌群，再用共振收束；避免连续空放。
RESOURCE_MANA_RULE.en:
MANA
Regenerates steadily. Deploy a node, control the enemy, then trigger resonance.

DOSSIER_NOTE.zh_CN: 出勤候选 / 预览不更换英雄

HERO_CH01_PLAY.zh_CN:
罗砧「开路工」
近战破阵 · 怒气驱动
战斧横扫、突进与反推。越靠近敌群越有力量，也需要选择承压时机。
HERO_CH01_PLAY.en:
Melee / Rage
Axe sweeps, a charge and a counter.
Close in and time your guard.

HERO_CH02_PLAY.zh_CN:
岑线「引路针」
精准游猎 · 能量驱动
贯穿长射、滑步换位与陷阱。保持距离，用走位创造下一次开火窗口。
HERO_CH02_PLAY.en:
Ranged / Energy
Piercing shots, a slide and traps.
Keep moving between bursts.

HERO_CH03_PLAY.zh_CN:
谷频「拾频者」
区域共鸣 · 法力驱动
节点部署、寒冷控制与共振爆发。规划阵地，把敌群引入能量交汇处。
HERO_CH03_PLAY.en:
Area control / Mana
Nodes, cold control and resonance.
Shape a field; lure enemies into it.

HERO_SWITCH_NOTE.zh_CN: 免费切换。各英雄的经验独立保存，仓库装备共享。
HERO_SWITCH_NOTE.en: Switch freely. Each hero retains their own XP; equipment is shared.

SKILL_READY.zh_CN: 已解锁 · 消耗 {cost} · 冷却 {cooldown}s

SKILL_LOCKED.zh_CN: 等级 {level} 解锁 · 消耗 {cost} · 冷却 {cooldown}s

SKILL_PROGRESS_NOTE.zh_CN: 角色经验在远征中积累。1 级可用普攻、冲刺与 Q；2 / 3 / 4 级依次解锁右键 / F / R。
SKILL_PROGRESS_NOTE.en: Gain hero XP in expeditions. Basic attack, dash and Q are available at level 1; right click, F and R unlock at levels 2, 3 and 4.

UNLOCK_TRACK.zh_CN: 角色成长刻度 / 已达到的节点以浅绿标记
UNLOCK_TRACK.en: HERO GROWTH / REACHED MILESTONES IN GREEN

UNLOCK_LEGEND.zh_CN: 1—4 主动技能 / 10—16 技能强化 / 18—20 改型分支
UNLOCK_LEGEND.en: 1–4 active skills / 10–16 skill upgrades / 18–20 branch choices

NO_EQUIPMENT.zh_CN:
当前筛选没有装备。
可前往采购目录或切换筛选。
NO_EQUIPMENT.en:
No equipment matches.
Visit the shop or change your filters.

EQUIP_NOTE.zh_CN: 挂载免费。下次远征使用当前配装。
EQUIP_NOTE.en: Free to equip. Your next expedition uses this loadout.

PURCHASE_NOTE.zh_CN: 消耗 {cost} 营地金币，永久加入共享仓库。
PURCHASE_NOTE.en: Spend {cost} camp gold. Keep this item in the shared inventory.

INSUFFICIENT_GOLD.zh_CN: 需要 {cost} 金币。余额不足，先完成远征带回金币。
INSUFFICIENT_GOLD.en: Requires {cost} gold. Extract from expeditions to earn more.

UPGRADE_NOTE.zh_CN: 消耗 {cost} 金币，强化一级，最高 +5。
UPGRADE_NOTE.en: Spend {cost} gold to refine one level, up to +5.

SET_THRESHOLDS.zh_CN: 套装在 2 / 4 / 6 件时解锁对应加成。
SET_THRESHOLDS.en: Set bonuses unlock at 2 / 4 / 6 fitted pieces.

AFFIX_UNAVAILABLE.zh_CN: 词条尚未开放，暂不销售此装备。
AFFIX_UNAVAILABLE.en: Affix unavailable in this build. This item is not yet for sale.

RESULT_HERO_XP.zh_CN:
本次角色经验 +{xp}
当前角色等级 {level}
RESULT_HERO_XP.en:
Hero XP earned +{xp}
Current hero level {level}

UPGRADE_CAPPED.zh_CN: 当前配装已达到相关属性上限。更换配装后可再强化。
UPGRADE_CAPPED.en: This build has reached the relevant stat cap. Change your loadout before refining.

UPGRADE_ROUNDING.zh_CN: 本级可能因取整暂不增加显示值；后续等级继续累积。
UPGRADE_ROUNDING.en: Rounding may leave the displayed value unchanged this level; later levels keep scaling.

SET_LOSE.zh_CN: 替换将失去：{set} {count} 件效果

CORE_ACTIONS_UNLOCK.zh_CN: 普攻、被动、冲刺：1 级可用

DASH_DETAILS.zh_CN:
最远 {distance} 距离 / 冷却 {cooldown}s / 无资源消耗
地形会阻挡移动。零资源仍可使用。
DASH_DETAILS.en:
Up to {distance} range / {cooldown}s cooldown / no resource cost
Terrain blocks movement. Available at zero resource.

BRANCH_RULE.zh_CN: 同组只能选择一种改型，也可保留原版。营地免费重选；本次远征开始后固定。每名英雄独立保存。
BRANCH_RULE.en: Choose one option per group, or keep the original. Change freely at camp; choices lock when you depart. Saved separately for each hero.

ROOM_LOAD_FAILED_NOTE.zh_CN: 房间未能加载，请返回营地后重试。
ROOM_LOAD_FAILED_NOTE.en: The room could not be loaded. Return to camp and try again.

DEPARTURE_ENEMY_COUNT.zh_CN: 首个房间 · 共 {count} 名敌人

COMBAT_LEDGER.zh_CN: 作战仪表 · 技能与携行

HUD_FINAL_COST.zh_CN: 当前消耗 {cost} {resource} · 冷却 {cooldown} 秒

HUD_REMAINING.zh_CN: 冷却中 · 剩余 {time} 秒

HUD_DETAIL_HINT.zh_CN:
按键施放 · 点击或 Enter 查看完整详情
Tab 暂停并展开作战仪表
HUD_DETAIL_HINT.en:
Use the hotkey to cast. Click or Enter for details.
Tab pauses and opens combat instruments.

HUD_BASE_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 基础技能档案（等级、装备及分支后的实际消耗与冷却见上方）
HUD_BASE_DESCRIPTION.en: Base skill dossier. Current cost and cooldown above include level, equipment and branch changes.

HUD_DASH_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 沿移动方向冲刺；未移动时朝准星方向冲刺。每位角色的距离与冷却不同。
HUD_DASH_DESCRIPTION.en: Dash in the movement direction, or toward the reticle when stationary. Distance and cooldown depend on the hero.

HUD_WALLET_NOTE.zh_CN:
撤离保留全部携带金币；死亡保留50%，主动放弃保留50%（向下取整）。
点击或 Tab 查看携行详情。
HUD_WALLET_NOTE.en:
Extraction keeps all carried gold. Death keeps 50%; abandoning keeps 50%, rounded down.
Click or Tab to inspect your loadout.

HUD_WALLET_TOTAL.zh_CN: 金币 {gold} · 死亡保留 {kept}（50%）· 放弃保留50% · 撤离全额
